title: Property taxes and fund classification — City of Ashford
instructions: The City of Ashford (60-day availability period) levied property taxes for its fiscal year. Classify the transactions by fund and compute the property tax amounts.

exhibits.title: Property tax levy
exhibits.content:
Levy for the year: **$5,000,000**; estimated uncollectible: **2%**.
Collected during the year: **$4,600,000**.
Collected in the first 60 days after year-end: **$150,000**; the rest is expected later.

exhibits.title: Other activities
exhibits.content:
1. Water utility billing residents for usage
2. Bond proceeds restricted to building a new library
3. Gas tax revenues legally restricted to road maintenance
4. Accumulating resources to pay principal and interest on general obligation bonds
5. A central motor pool that charges city departments
6. An endowment whose earnings (but not principal) support park upkeep

parts.prompt: Property tax amounts for the year.

rows.label: General fund property tax revenue (modified accrual)
Deferred inflows of resources — property taxes
Government-wide property tax revenue
rows.explanation: Accrual basis: levy net of uncollectibles, 5,000,000 × 98% = **4,900,000**.

parts.prompt: Select the fund for each activity.

rows.explanation: Fees charged to external users for services.
Resources restricted to acquiring major capital facilities.
Revenue restricted to a specified purpose other than debt or capital projects.
Accumulates resources for general long-term debt service.
Services provided to other departments on a cost-reimbursement basis.
Principal must be preserved; earnings support the government's programs.
